column1: # Pinned manifest for the Finnish spelling engine.
# Finnish is agglutinative: its words are generated, not listed, so no
# Hunspell .aff/.dic pair for it exists upstream and none could. Spell checking
# it needs a morphological analyser -- libvoikko plus the voikko-fi vfst
# transducer -- so the `fi` tag ships a DIFFERENT kind of dictionary from the
# other 35, in the same resources/dictionaries tree.
# bundle-voikko.ps1 fetches two pinned upstream archives, verifies each against
# the sha256 in the script, and writes resources/dictionaries/fi/. Every file it
# writes has a row below, verified by sha256 before it lands.
# COLUMNS: file <TAB> component <TAB> role <TAB> sha256 <TAB> spdx <TAB> notice <TAB> source
#   file      path as shipped, relative to resources/dictionaries/fi/
#   component upstream project
#   role      binary | module | data | notice | runtime
#             `runtime` is copied from resources/tesseract, not fetched: the
#             same three mingw DLLs already ship there with their own rows in
#             scripts/tesseract-licenses.tsv, so they are accounted for once
#             and copied beside libvoikko-1.dll because a DLL loaded out of
#             resources/dictionaries/fi cannot see the OCR runtime's directory.
#   sha256    of the shipped file. `-` for a runtime row, whose bytes are
#             whatever bundle-tesseract.ps1 vendored.
#   spdx      SPDX expression. "OR" = we may rely on any listed licence.
#   notice    filename under fi/notices/ carrying the text that choice requires
#   source    upstream the file came from
# RULES
#  - Every shipped binary needs a row whose notice file is present.
#    bundle-voikko.ps1 REFUSES to write the tree otherwise, and refuses just as
#    hard when the tree holds a file with no row -- drift in either direction
#    stops the build rather than shipping unnotified bytes.
#  - libvoikko is tri-licensed; MPL-1.1 is the option this project exercises,
#    and all three are recorded because the notice files carry all three.
#  - voikko-fi is GPL-2.0-or-later. That is an ordinary row: this project is
#    MIT open source with a public repository, so the source column answers
#    "where is the source".
# -WriteManifest re-fetches and writes the sha256 column back instead of
# verifying it. That is the pin-bump path: change the pins in the script, run
# it once, review the diff, commit. Never wired into a build.
